summary.text: David Hale is a Republican member of the Kentucky House of Representatives representing District 74, serving since 2015. The legislature's profile lists Hale as chair of the House State Government Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's profile, David Hale is a pastor and retired from the Kentucky Department of Fish & Wildlife.
The profile lists a 1974 graduation from Menifee County High School and involvement with the Kentucky Ministries Association and Horizons of Hope.
